summary: Implemented an internal Aho-Corasick literal-set matcher and one-traversal/one-read scope coordinator that preserve independent per-pattern non-overlap, cross-pattern overlaps and duplicate pattern identity.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

startingState.head: 3198fe94059cad41bad46604e2dfd8ce5ac2f165
startingState.worktree: Tracked files were clean at scope start; ignored campaign state recorded W08-S02 as in_progress.
startingState.aheadNote: The ahead count includes the reachable completed Search scope commits through W08-S01 and other pre-existing branch commits; no upstream changes were present.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the internal text-matcher seam, literal-set engine/coordinator, focused Search tests and the semantics boundary note were changed. Existing single-pattern behavior remains on the same scanner; public search.many metadata, SQL constructor binding and regex execution were not added.

engine.algorithm: Aho-Corasick trie with failure links and labeled terminal outputs
engine.selection: leftmost-first non-overlapping independently per pattern ID
engine.equalPatternText: distinct IDs remain distinct terminal outputs
engine.casePolicy: sensitive or invariant one-code-unit insensitive matching, matching the existing LiteralMatcher policy
engine.recordPolicy: LF resets automaton state; literals containing LF produce no cross-record match
engine.regexPolicy: reject before scope enumeration; no literal fallback

scanCoordinator.eligibleReads: one SearchTextScanner scan and injected reader-factory call per eligible file
scanCoordinator.resultBuffering: callback delivery; no repository-wide match materialization
scanCoordinator.coordinates: reuses the existing UTF-16 line/column and original-byte coordinate path

newScenarios: Preserve prefix matches and equal pattern text under distinct labels
Keep cross-pattern overlaps while selecting each pattern non-overlapping
Carry labeled spans and line coordinates across reader chunks
Compile and search the bounded 1,024-pattern set
Apply whole-word boundaries independently per label
Traverse once and open each eligible file once with measured counters
Reject regex-labeled input before any scope or reader access

commands.executionWrapper: Direct PowerShell invocation with separate stdout/stderr capture; captured logs were normalized to UTF-8 LF for deterministic hashing.

commands.argv: git diff --check; source manifest and artifact hash validation

gateResults.evidence: The focused Search Release suite exited 0 with 181 discovered, 178 passed, 0 failed and 3 platform-conditional skips; the exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 across 21 projects with 1,465 discovered, 1,431 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips.

The separate ownership review approved the matcher algorithm, independent selection state, scanner seam, resource boundary and public-surface boundary; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained.
Focused matcher tests cover the required labeled prefix, overlap, duplicate-text, chunk-boundary and large-set cases, including independent same-pattern non-overlap and whole-word behavior.
No public SQL constructor or schema/XML metadata was changed. The semantics documentation explicitly records the internal literal-only foundation and does not advertise search.many execution.

The matcher uses bounded trie/ring state, checks cancellation during matching, delegates reader lifetime to the existing scanner and delivers matches through a callback without repository-wide buffering; invalid regex modes are rejected before I/O.

knownLimitations: This scope implements the internal literal-set engine and scan coordinator only. Public search.many source metadata, constructor binding, compiled-query execution and regex-labeled execution remain later W08 scopes; no unverified SQL constructor is advertised.

Literal patterns containing LF are admitted by the request parser but intentionally produce no cross-record match, matching the existing physical-line literal boundary; explicit multiline interpretation remains later work.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips; no package was published, pushed, released or installed.
